notes.title: Update 3: Difficulty Settings Now Available
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,


Update #3
[v1.05]

[h2][b]Difficulty Levels are implemented.
Presets: [Easy] [Normal] [Hard][/b][/h2]

[h3]Starting Money: [40k] [20k] [10k][/h3]
It's how much money you want to start with.

[h3]Bankruptcy:  [OFF] [-10000] [-5000][/h3]
[-5000]: Your factory will go bankrupt when your balance drops to -5000.
[-10000]: Your factory will go bankrupt when your balance drops to -10000.
[OFF]:  Your factory will never go bankrupt.

[h3]Robot Level-up: [Fast] [Normal] [Slow][/h3]
If set to fast, your robots will level-up faster.

[h3]Factory Level-up: [Fast] [Normal] [Slow][/h3]
If set to fast, you will get more XP per product.

[h3]Market Difficulty: [Easy] [Normal] [Hard][/h3]
It affects market prices and special order time-limits.

[h3]Market Stability: [Stable] [Normal] [Unstable][/h3]
It affects price-difference between market-cycles.
If set to unstable, high price-changes may occur.

[h3]Robot Charge & Oil Capacity: [High] [Normal] [Low][/h3]
It affects the frequency of robots going to chargers and lubricators.
If set to high, robots go to chargers and lubricators less frequently.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41522850/905f3bd90b1d97c58a93441585207ab1bd1f257a.jpg[/img]

Please keep reporting if you see anything! 
Thanks so much for all the support!

notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just updated the game by considering your feedback.
Your save-files will work but we suggest you start over. Otherwise, it may cause some unknown issues.

- Economy&Statistics section shows the "Daily Costs".
- Building names are now editable.
- Zoom-in and zoom-out key-bindings are added to Options-Control.
- Save-name character-limit is updated to 24.


Thanks for your understanding!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755300/Smart_Factory_Tycoon/
